title: Fetch one document (ChatGPT connector contract)
description: Returns one knowledge record in full, by the string id a search result gave: title, the full text in the source's words, the URL to cite, and metadata with the source, licence and date. It is the ChatGPT connector counterpart of get_entity, which gives only an excerpt. Use it after search, or with a search_knowledge id as a string. Give field, a JSON pointer such as /questIds, to read one value of the record's data: text then holds that value as JSON, and an array comes in pages of up to 48 rows with nextOffset for the next page. A long array in a whole record is cut at 48 rows. The text block is the same JSON as a string.

id.description: An id from a search result.

field.description: A JSON pointer into the record's data, such as /criteria or /reagents/0. Without it, the whole record.

offset.description: Row to start at when the field is an array; default 0. Use nextOffset from the last answer.

limit.description: Rows per answer, default and at most 48.

id.description: The record id as a string.

text.description: The whole record, in the source's words.

url.description: Where the record is read, as in search.

sourceUrl.description: Where the record came from. Keep it with the text.

licence.description: The source's licence, such as CC-BY-SA-4.0.

credit.description: The credit line to show with the text.

confirmed.description: Present when player uploads confirm this game-file entry (3 or more installs agree). asOf is the date the rollup was current.

field.description: Present when field was given and found.

value.description: The value at the pointer. An array is one page of up to 48 rows.

nextOffset.description: Present when more rows remain: pass it as offset.

keys.description: Present when field was given and not found: the keys of the deepest object the pointer reached. Empty when the record has no structured data.

x-everloot-output.note: The text block is the structured answer as a JSON string, as OpenAI's connector contract asks.
